entries.title: Feedback keeps an unsent report as a draft
entries.body: If you close the Feedback box, or the page, before sending, what you wrote and the kind of report you chose are kept in this browser for your account and come back when you reopen it. Screenshots are not kept. Sending or signing out clears the draft, and a draft older than a week is dropped.

entries.title: Leftover old names match the Sources mode
entries.body: A few places still used old names for parts of Sources. An article's data download names its files for the bibliography and Sources claims, not citations and debate; a shared article's list of what was built says a bibliography and a Reception search; the privacy page says Reception. Older links to a sorted or filtered Reception list still work.

entries.title: Send in Feedback no longer stalls after dictating
entries.body: After dictating into the Feedback box, Send could look ready and do nothing. It now stops the microphone, or waits for your words to be written out, and sends once they arrive; a stalled send gives up rather than hanging. Wherever you dictate, pressing Stop twice quickly sends or saves rather than turning the microphone back on.
